rebuttal_or_critique: While my economic assessment remains that a 'neutral' stance is the most accurate reflection of the current policy environment, I recognize the committee's overwhelming focus on the 7.44% headline inflation print. The current food price spike is clearly supply-side driven, and with core inflation at 4.90%, I remain fundamentally opposed to further rate hikes which would only serve to impede the 7.80% GVA growth momentum. However, to ensure the MPC speaks with a unified voice regarding our commitment to the inflation mandate, I will concede to the 'withdrawal_of_accommodation' stance for this meeting, provided there is no further increase in the repo rate.
